subject: math

objective.text: See that a digit is worth 10 times the same digit one place right. Multiply and divide by 10.

explanations.title: Build the chart to 1 million
explanations.text: 10 hundreds make 1 thousand. 10 thousands make 1 ten thousand. 10 ten thousands make 1 hundred thousand. 10 hundred thousands make 1 million.

explanations.title: Bundle and move left
explanations.text: When you have 10 of one unit, bundle them. Move the bundle to the next column on the left.

explanations.title: Multiply many copies by 10
explanations.text: 10 × 4 ten thousands = 40 ten thousands = 4 hundred thousands. The unit gets 10 times as big.

explanations.title: Divide by unbundling
explanations.text: To divide 2 thousands by 10, unbundle each thousand into 10 hundreds. 20 hundreds ÷ 10 = 2 hundreds.

explanations.title: Two units at once
explanations.text: Put two units in parentheses to show one number. Multiply or divide both units by 10.

hints.text: Count up by threes. Think about getting to the next ten first.
Say each digit with its unit, like 4 thousands 2 tens.
Bundle the smaller units into one larger unit. Count how many you bundle.
Multiplying by 10 makes each unit one place bigger. Dividing makes it one place smaller.
Unbundle each unit into 10 smaller units. Then divide.
Multiply or divide both units. Then put the number in standard form.
Multiply the number of trays by the muffins in each tray.
Multiply by 10. Think of 10 copies of each unit.
Subtract the smaller number from the larger number.
